description: Source-original downloads, web derivatives, captions and standalone image records, subject to per-file rights verification.

items.title: Tuki's map of Aotearoa, drawn in 1793
items.credit: Tuki Te Terenui Whare Pirau; Alexander Turnbull Library, MapColl-CHA-2/1/9-Acc.36440
items.caption: Map of Aotearoa drawn by Tuki Te Terenui Whare Pirau in 1793 and published in 1798. The map records geographic and cultural knowledge, including places and routes in the northern North Island.
items.context: This is a surviving copy of a Māori manuscript map. It predates computer mapping and is included to illustrate knowledge represented geographically before modern surveying and GIS.
items.altText: Historical manuscript map of New Zealand attributed to Tuki, published in 1798.

items.title: Waikaka Survey District cadastral map, 1888
items.credit: Drawn by J. M. Kemp; Archives New Zealand, DABB D101 423/IN 3939 (R6617915)
items.caption: 1888 cadastral survey map of Waikaka Survey District, showing the paper parcel records that preceded the digital cadastre.
items.context: An original cadastral mapping product rather than a reconstructed GIS example. Source archive reference is printed in the source record.
items.altText: Late nineteenth-century cadastral survey map showing parcel boundaries in Waikaka Survey District.

items.title: Aerial survey of Wrights Hill, Wellington, 1945
items.credit: Retrolens / New Zealand historic aerial survey SN373, Run B, Photo 15; original photographer unidentified
items.caption: Vertical aerial photograph of Wrights Hill Fortress, Wellington, taken on 28 September 1945 from approximately 11,000 feet. Survey SN373, Run B, frame 15.
items.context: Useful evidence of systematic national aerial surveying and the images later digitised for GIS. The original capture survey and frame are known.
items.altText: Black-and-white vertical 1945 aerial photograph of Wrights Hill Fortress and nearby roads.

items.title: Victoria Square, Christchurch, in 1955 aerial imagery
items.credit: LINZ; New Zealand Aerial Mapping; New Zealand Aerial Surveys; RNZAF; Canterbury Maps
items.caption: Aerial photograph of Victoria Square, Christchurch, around 1955, subsequently accessible through Canterbury Maps' historical imagery collection.
items.context: A concrete example of local government's preservation and digital delivery of historical aerial data. This image is not a 1990s GIS screenshot.
items.altText: Black-and-white aerial photograph of central Christchurch and Victoria Square around 1955.

items.title: QMAP geology of the Christchurch area, 2008
items.credit: P. J. Forsyth, D. J. A. Barrell and R. Jongens (compilers); GNS Science
items.caption: GNS Science QMAP 1:250,000 geological map of the Christchurch area, compiled by Forsyth, Barrell and Jongens in 2008.
items.context: Example of national-scale digital geological mapping with detailed lithology and stratigraphic interpretation. The large original should be available at full resolution for reading its legend.
items.altText: Colour geological QMAP sheet and legend for Canterbury and Christchurch.

items.commonsTitle: File:Christchurch and Banks Peninsula from space, 2001, Landsat 7 ETM.jpg
items.title: Landsat 7 observation of Christchurch, 2001
items.credit: NASA Earth Observatory, Jesse Allen; Landsat 7 Science Team
items.caption: Landsat 7 ETM+ satellite observation of Christchurch, the Canterbury Plains and Banks Peninsula, acquired on 25 September 2001.
items.context: An authentic image from a named sensor and acquisition date, suitable for showing the spatial coverage and analytical potential of satellite imagery.
items.altText: Landsat view of Christchurch, braided rivers, Canterbury Plains and Banks Peninsula.

items.commonsTitle: File:Christchurch from space, 4 March 2011, showing quake shaking strength, with key.png
items.title: Mapping Christchurch earthquake shaking, March 2011
items.credit: NASA Earth Observatory, Robert Simmon; EO-1 ALI data and USGS Earthquake Hazard Program; legend adapted by Wikimedia contributor Avenue
items.caption: Satellite view of Christchurch on 4 March 2011, annotated with earthquake shaking measurements and a colour key following the 22 February 2011 earthquake.
items.context: Retrospective analytical earthquake map. It does not depict the live emergency management common operating picture.
items.altText: Aerial view of Christchurch overlaid with coloured circles indicating 2011 earthquake ground shaking intensity and a colour key.

items.title: Ruapehu terrain visualised with satellite and radar data, 2002
items.credit: NASA Earth Observatory; Landsat processing Laura Rocchio; Shuttle Radar Topography Mission team / NASA/JPL/NIMA
items.caption: Perspective terrain image of Mount Ruapehu and Hauhungatahi made from Landsat satellite imagery and Shuttle Radar Topography Mission elevation data, 2002.
items.context: Illustrates genuine 3D elevation modelling; retain the existing chapter image as a separate asset and do not mistake this for a photograph from an aircraft.
items.altText: Oblique three-dimensional terrain visualisation of Mount Ruapehu with satellite-coloured topography.

items.title: OpenStreetMap map of central Auckland, 2018
items.credit: © OpenStreetMap contributors; cartographic file via Wikimedia Commons
items.caption: Community-produced OpenStreetMap cartography of Auckland's central business district, published in July 2018.
items.context: Shows an actual NZ map output using openly maintained geographic data. Underlying OpenStreetMap database attribution is retained.
items.altText: Colour street map of central Auckland sourced from OpenStreetMap community data.

items.title: Black-and-white OpenStreetMap map of central Auckland
items.credit: © OpenStreetMap contributors; cartographic file via Wikimedia Commons
items.caption: Black-and-white OpenStreetMap street map of central Auckland, 2018, illustrating a reusable cartographic output from community geographic data.
items.context: A rendered map product, not an interface screenshot or proof of a specific commercial web application.
items.altText: Black-and-white street map of Auckland central business district.

items.title: USGS ShakeMap of the Kaikōura earthquake, 2016
items.dateDisplay: 13 November 2016 (event; map subsequently revised to April 2017)
items.caption: USGS ShakeMap showing the estimated shaking intensity associated with the November 2016 Kaikōura earthquake, in a later revised edition.
items.context: This image was revised after the earthquake; use the version date recorded with its source rather than describing it as the first operational map.
items.altText: USGS colour-coded shaking intensity map of the 2016 Kaikōura earthquake.

items.commonsTitle: File:PIA21210 - Satellite Radar Show Complex Set of Faults Moved in 2016 New Zealand Earthquake.jpg
items.title: Radar measurements of Kaikōura earthquake deformation
items.credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/JAXA/Google Earth; ARIA and ALOS-2 PALSAR-2 teams
items.licence: Public-domain claim on Commons, with third-party JAXA and Google Earth content; hold for source-specific confirmation
items.caption: Satellite radar interferometry maps of the surface displacement associated with the 2016 Kaikōura earthquake, derived from ALOS-2 images.
items.context: The source credits third-party data and Google Earth imagery. Download only to a pending local research directory until rights for website reproduction are resolved.
items.altText: Two false-colour satellite radar displacement maps of the 2016 Kaikōura earthquake.
